headline: President Trump signed an executive order titled "Urgent National Action To Save College Sports" on April 3, 2026.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with college sports. No official summary was available, so its specific rules, directions to federal agencies, and deadlines cannot be described here. The title says the order calls for urgent national action on college athletics.

who_it_affects.how: The order concerns college sports, but the available information does not say how it changes anything for athletes.

who_it_affects.group: Colleges and universities with athletic programs
who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at college sports, but the specific effects on schools are not described in the available information.
